technique_name: Write a factual description of the African wild dog
description: The African Wild Dog, or Lycaon pictus, is a medium-sized mammal native to Sub-Saharan Africa. It is the only species in its genus and is the largest of the African canines. African Wild Dogs have a light brown coat with large, round ears and distinctive black and white markings. They are social creatures and live in packs of around 8-11 individuals.
